summary: Discover and journal the loaded legacy daemon's launchd domain for host migration

schema.detail: Host cutover journals now record launchd_domain. Old macOS journals missing it fail closed with manual recovery guidance; Linux recovery is unchanged.

rules.detail: New macOS cutovers require one loaded recognized legacy daemon across gui/<uid> and user/<uid>, and refuse split-domain jobs.

compatibility.detail: The mover supports a pre-staged user-domain daemon and reports its domain. Home Manager, CLI staging, fresh installation and app-installer domain handling are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Existing bounded host-swap downtime and API commit fence are unchanged.

manual.detail: Dry run reports launchd_domain. Resolve missing, duplicate or split-domain ownership before migration; no override bypasses discovery.

recovery.detail: Rollback and committed recovery bind to the journal's validated domain before inspection, even after login-session changes. Preserve journals without launchd_domain and follow their manual GUI-host recovery diagnostic.
